# Plan review — panel position 1

Cross-checked plan claims against the live pilot at `01292042`, `sprint/chunks.json`, the runner’s `_format_chunk_spec` path, and the already-rendered executor prompt. Factual baseline (branch, RED assertion, hash lock, 90/1/89, Flask 3.1.3, handler lines, C6 prefix string behavior) holds. The material defect is enforcement-path inconsistency, not bad diagnosis.

---

  "recommended_change": "Amend sprint/chunks.json in the same re-hash round so runner-fed chunk_spec carries at least: (1) C6 path rule as an observable criterion or scope sentence the executor cannot miss; (2) the non-API body command `pytest test/test_public_routes.py::test_unknown_path_returns_404_page`; (3) optional compileall + base-pinned scope commands if those stay in AC. Drop or reverse OQ-8’s default that plan-only marking is enough. Do not rely on a result-block shape the executor prompt never requests.",
  "risk_if_ignored": "Hard constraints promoted in round 1 (C6) and anti-silent-green gates (AC-5/AC-9, R2/R10) never enter the only document the runner injects into executor and validator context. A chunks.json-faithful executor can satisfy all runner-enforced criteria while violating C6 (e.g. `path.startswith('/api')` → `/apiary` JSON) or rewriting the HTML body past the un-run public-routes guard. Validators asked only for chunk_spec conformance have no standing criterion to reject that."
}

## Consistency notes (not separate findings)

| Area | Assessment |
|---|---|
| Pilot-spec alignment (criteria 1–5) | Consistent with locked tests and chunks.json minimum |
| Baseline / valid-RED | Reproduced: exit 1 at `test_api_routes.py:344`, `text/html; charset=utf-8`; full suite `1 failed, 89 passed` of 90 |
| Lock hash | `2cf0003eba6b7e7701df74305fc291405961b3bffadcd5290a7c299d26abb2ea` matches file + lock manifest |
| Rollback | Internally consistent for uncommitted vs post-commit; matches chunks.json rollback for the uncommitted case |
| Implementation non-prescription | Honored (PRD §5.5) — no handler algorithm dictated |
| Round-1 dispositions (F-a3c91b, F-b19c55, lint, body bytes) | Present in the document; C6 promotion is the right intent, but carriage into runner artifacts did not follow |
| Family seats | Planner anthropic vs reviewers xai/google; executor zhipu vs validators grok/kimi — §17.2 shape OK on paper |
